press_references.value: Heron Expands into SMB Credit Broker Market with Full Deal Flow Automation

product_launches.description: Heron Data launched Heron Broker Suite, an end-to-end AI solution automating SMB credit broker deal flow from application intake to CRM.

overview_description.description: Heron Data provides infrastructure that enables financial institutions and fintech companies to analyze business bank transactions and extract structured insights. The company focuses on automating underwriting and financial analysis by transforming raw transaction data into standardized, machine-readable formats. Its software integrates with various data sources to classify, enrich, and label transaction streams, helping teams make faster and more informed credit decisions. Heron Data serves lenders, neobanks, and other financial platforms that require scalable and accurate transaction data analysis. The platform also offers tools for understanding cash flow, detecting financial risk, and tracking business health over time. Through these capabilities, Heron Data helps financial teams streamline operations and reduce manual review workloads.

product.name: Heron Data Platform
product.description: An AI-powered document automation platform that receives, classifies, extracts, enriches, evaluates, and synchronizes data from financial and insurance documents.

product.name: Heron for SMB Finance
product.description: Document intake and underwriting automation for funders and brokers that converts business funding submissions into structured, decision-ready data.

product.name: Heron for Insurance
product.description: Submission and claims-document automation for insurers, MGAs, and brokers that classifies, extracts, validates, and routes insurance documents.

product.name: Heron Broker Suite
product.description: A broker-focused workflow for turning funder offer emails and submission documents into structured CRM updates and faster deal processing.

product.name: Heron API and CRM Integrations
product.description: API-driven connectivity that sends extracted and enriched document data into CRMs, underwriting platforms, and custom systems.
